parameters.script: const get=()=>({url:location.href,rows:Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('table tbody tr')).map(tr=>tr.innerText.trim()).filter(Boolean),summary:(document.body.innerText.match(/Showing[^\n]*/)||[])[0]||'',page:(document.body.innerText.match(/Page \d+ of \d+/)||[])[0]||''}); const pages=[]; for(let i=0;i<4;i++){const s=get(); pages.push({summary:s.summary,page:s.page,matches:s.rows.filter(x=>x.includes('EFREG008'))}); const b=document.querySelector('button[aria-label="Next page"]'); if(!b||b.disabled) break; b.click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,500));} return {pages,allMatches:pages.flatMap(p=>p.matches),controlVisible:pages.flatMap(p=>p.matches).some(x=>x.includes('SubmittedWithReceipt')),url:location.href};
